verdict.rationale: Braintrust is an observability and eval platform, not an agent itself, so shipping an MCP server is a fair axis. Its first-party docs describe an official MCP integration that connects Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and any other MCP-compatible client to query logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring and Topics, and run evals, and a probe independently confirms the official MCP server page exists. missing for 10: details of the tool list and authentication/setup in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other MCP clients to Braintrust. Query logs, author scorers, configure Topics, and run evals from your editor.
Query production logs, author prompts and scorers, configure monitoring, and run evals from Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, and any other MCP-compatible client.
